title: Sorted archive with appended episodes
summary: Every episode is appended to an archive that stays sorted by its first coordinate; a probe finds the nearest archived episode by position in the sorted order.
core_idea: Append episodes to a sorted archive and answer probes by sorted position.

state.name: tessaly
state.meaning: Archive of episodes, appended in arrival order and kept sorted by the first coordinate.

learning.description: Nothing is learned; the archive keeps every episode.
learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: One stored pair is read back exactly.

capabilities.prediction: Exact recall of the stored value at its own key, for every stored pair.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: Sorted archives are a common index structure.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: A stored pair is read back wrongly.

toy_example.python:
import json
arc = sorted([(3, 'c'), (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')])
print(json.dumps({'first': arc[0][1], 'size': len(arc)}))
